prompt: Create a cheerful childlike illustration of a koala hanging from a horizontal tree branch with both arms, centered slightly left. The koala has a rounded gray body, large round ears with cream inner ear shapes, big white circular eyes with black pupils, a large vertical black oval nose, a small smiling mouth, two short legs raised outward, and tiny clawed paws gripping the branch. Use a bright cyan-blue sky background with exactly 2 blocky white clouds, one large cloud on the left edge and one smaller cloud on the right. Place a thick brown tree trunk on the right side rising vertically and forking near the top, with one horizontal branch extending left across the upper third of the image. Add exactly 3 green leafy clusters: one rounded cluster at the far left end of the branch, one small cluster at the lower right edge of the trunk, and one small cluster near the bottom center-right beside the trunk. Style the whole image like a handmade preschool poster or oil-pastel drawing: bold uneven black outlines, visible crayon or paint texture, simple flat colors, slightly wobbly shapes, playful proportions, no text, no realism, landscape 4:3 composition.

promptZh: 创作一幅欢快的儿童风格插图，描绘 一只考拉 用双臂挂在水平的树枝上，位置略微偏左。考拉拥有圆润的灰色身体、带有奶油色内耳的大圆耳朵、白色大圆眼配黑色瞳孔、一个巨大的垂直黑色椭圆形鼻子、一张微笑着的小嘴、两条向外抬起的短腿，以及抓着树枝的细小爪子。使用明亮的青蓝色天空作为背景，并添加恰好 2 朵块状白云，左边缘一朵较大的云，右侧一朵较小的云。在右侧放置一根粗壮的棕色树干，垂直向上并在顶部附近分叉，其中一根水平树枝向左延伸至图像上三分之一处。添加恰好 3 簇绿色叶子：树枝最左端一簇圆形的叶子、树干右下边缘一簇小的叶子，以及树干旁右下方中心附近一簇小的叶子。整幅图像采用手工制作的学龄前海报或油画棒绘画风格：粗犷且不均匀的黑色轮廓、可见的蜡笔或颜料质感、简单的平涂色彩、略显歪斜的形状、俏皮的比例，无文字，无写实感，采用 4:3 横向构图。
